nodes.label: SYSTEM.md: how GLUE works now
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for how GLUE functions today; updated when implementation changes

nodes.label: GLUE window: GLUE Home's own window (ADR 0151)
nodes.rationale: Tray and 'Open GLUE library' open live site in GLUE Home's window (?app=window); only site stays in it; other links go to browser; Google sign-in is popup; downloads go to Downloads

nodes.label: GLUE folder: user's data in JSON files
nodes.rationale: Chosen on first run (usually Documents/GLUE) or kept in OPFS; mco.json (profiles, lastProfile, aliases, container, computer, appearance); profiles/<pid>/profile.json; collections/<cid>/ (collection.json, tracks, analysis, lists, sources, events.json, dupes, files, backups, cloud/shared)

nodes.label: Local link to GLUE Home (ADR 0048)
nodes.rationale: http://127.0.0.1:47400-47409; /hello, /connect, /fs/*, /cache, /rpc (engine in Rust), /lease, /attach, /incoming, /dock, /folders; every route but /hello and /connect needs token

nodes.label: Service page: hidden GLUE Home work (ADR 0153)
nodes.rationale: Engine in Rust since 0.52 (crates/glue-engine); analysis pool; FLAC decoding; shared sync; song info write; backups; duplicates; DJ libraries; reminders; updates; streaming; sessions; GLUE window

nodes.label: Analysis: where it runs and how
nodes.rationale: In GLUE Home where it runs (native, ADR 0148); otherwise in tab (worker pool, src/lib/pool.ts); makes summary (verdict, tier, bandwidth, bit depth, BPM, key), details, fingerprint, mini spectrogram, waveform; ANALYSIS_VERSION 3, VERDICT_VERSION 8

nodes.label: Profiles and library (ADR 0113, 0114)
nodes.rationale: Profile is artist alias (id, name, colour, BPM range); one GLUE folder has one library; signed in, account keeps list (union of every device's); BPM range belongs to alias; backup and cloud sync belong to library

nodes.label: Collections: music folders, DJ libraries, songs, playlists, analyses, events
nodes.rationale: Sidebar views count songs with analysisState function; show one row per song (best copy) except when file couldn't be analysed; table remembers scroll position; clicking artist/album/genre/label opens facet view

nodes.label: Shared form: account's collections on all devices
nodes.rationale: collection.json has shared, members (computer to library folder), rootsBy; song has copies[computer] (file on each); same file on two computers is one song with copy on each (ADR 0130); analyses per computer; here(meta, me) projects for this computer

hyperedges.label: GLUE Home architecture: local link, service page, engine, stores
